body.message:
Please find the 3-month rates for La Sirene below:

August: AED 8,500
September: AED 8,800
October: AED 9,900

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be processed on a monthly basis only, with each month consisting of 30 nights.

Kindly note that the above rates will be fixed for the full 3-month period.

Thank you.
